description: OFF-BALL RUN COMMITMENT 0.2 s -> 1.0 s. A FIVEFOLD INCREASE, DELIBERATELY BIG ENOUGH TO SEE. NO EXTRA RUNNERS, NO ATTACK-LEVEL CHANGE. SUPERSEDES tools/data/patches/offball-run-commit.json (0.5 s) - they edit the SAME two instructions, so apply one or the other, never both. WHAT vf3 IS. ActionSelectorManager::update (0x143d52470) makes two passes per tick. PASS 1 (loop at 0x143d526c0): for every team-mate slot whose assigned action id [teamAI+0x8f4c+slot*4] equals this selector's own id [sel+0x128], it calls sel->vf3 through vtable+0x18, and on TRUE calls 0x1442edf70(teamAI, slot), which CLEARS the assignment. PASS 2 (loop at 0x143d52794): each selector's vf2 (the dispatcher 0x143df1080) refills the freed slots by re-scoring all eleven players from scratch. vf3 is therefore the whole of the game's run hysteresis, and there is no memory between the passes - a player released in pass 1 is fully eligible again in pass 2 of the SAME tick. Worse, the release function pushes action id 0 into the 4-entry per-slot action ring at teamAI+0x8f78+slot*0x34, so an abort/re-win cycle RESETS the clock to zero. Churn is self-perpetuating. THE TIMER, READ INSTRUCTION BY INSTRUCTION FROM THE IMAGE THIS SESSION. Both live selectors compute the window identically: 'call 0x14533ea80' (which is literally 'movss xmm0,[rip->fps]; ret' - a pure fps getter), then 'mulss xmm0,[rip->0.2f]' (0x143df73a8 in ChanceSpaceRun::vf3 0x143df72d0, and 0x143e051b2 in DiagonalRun::vf3 0x143e05130 - THE RE-AIM SITES), then 'addss xmm0,[rip->0.5f]' (rounding), then cvttss2si, then 'cmp ebx,ecx' at 0x143df73bd / 'cmp ebx,eax' at 0x143e051c7, where ebx = elapsed = [rec+8] - [rec+4] of the per-slot action record fetched by 0x1442eda20. Below the threshold the run is protected. EVIDENCE (a-emulated, this session, tools/emu_offball_window.py): those four instructions were executed from the game's own bytes in Unicorn with xmm0 = fps and each candidate constant-pool cell overlaid on the mulss disp32, on BOTH the installed exe and the PRISTINE backup. Identical on both images and at both sites: 0.2f (stock) -> 12 frames = 0.20 s; 0.5f -> 30 frames; 1.0f -> 60 frames = 1.00 s; 1.5f -> 90; 2.0f -> 120; 3.0f -> 180. This spec re-aims both sites at the 1.0f cell 0x1478502b8, i.e. 12 frames -> 60 frames. WHAT IS *NOT* DELAYED - THIS IS WHY 1.0 s IS SAFE. The window only defers the 'this run no longer makes sense' tests. The urgent abort causes bypass it entirely and still fire at elapsed = 0: in ChanceSpaceRun, player+0x48c non-zero, the predicate 0x143d2f710, the controlled-player test against 0x144311e40, and 0x1442fbb50 > 1 with player+0x568 == 5; in DiagonalRun, match state != 1 (0x143e05148), [teamCtx+0x28d] == 0 (0x143e05163) and 'the runner has become the ball holder' (0x143e0516c, 'cmp [ctx+0x1c],edi'). A run still dies the instant the ball arrives or play stops. WHY IT IS AGGRESSION-NEUTRAL. No cap, quota or attack level is touched; the effective cap stays min(quota, maxSlots) as tested at 0x143df1651 / 0x143df165b. This only changes how long an already-granted run is protected from being re-litigated. HONEST TRADE-OFF. This does not create variety ACROSS players by itself - vf5's score has no memory, so on a frozen picture the same man wins every re-bid however long the window is. What it buys is PERSISTENCE: a run that starts is carried far enough to change the picture, and variety follows second-hand because the later selectors then see a stable residual pool for a second instead of one that reshuffles 30 times a second, and because a completed run moves the runner out of the 'deepest man' slot that wins ChanceSpaceRun's score. The cost is real: for up to a second a runner cannot be claimed by a LATER selector, and whether GoalGet (0x29) can still take him over depends on the per-action priority jump table 0x1442ed8d0, which is NOT decoded. WHAT YOU WILL SEE. Runners should stop checking and re-checking. At 0.2 s a marginal run is dropped and restarted several times in a stride; at 1.0 s the man goes. Watch a forward who starts to peel in behind - today he half-starts, stutters and resets; this should make him commit through the stride. WHAT WOULD FALSIFY IT: no visible difference (which means the flicker comes from the undecoded abort predicates 0x143d2f710 / 0x143e8a970, not the window length), or runners visibly glued to runs that have obviously died - in which case drop to the 0.5f cell 0x147850248 (disp 98 8E A5 03 / 8E B0 A4 03). EVIDENCE LEVEL: (a-emulated) the threshold for every candidate cell on both images; (b-disassembly) the two-pass update structure, the abort causes and the ring-reset behaviour; (c-inferred) that 1.0 s is the right size rather than 0.7 or 1.5 - nothing in the code suggests a value, and 1.0 s was chosen because 0.5 s has previously been too small to notice. LANDMINE: the 0.2f cell 0x1478501c0 is a COALESCED literal-pool cell - exe_census reports refcount=1165, writers=0, STATUS=shared - so its VALUE is never edited; only the one instruction's disp32 is re-aimed. The destination 0x1478502b8 (1.0f) is the same kind of cell, refcount=13240, writers=0, which is exactly why it is safe as a READ target and must never be written. BYTES: both expect strings verified byte-identical in the installed exe and the PRISTINE backup; the destination 0x1478502b8 reads 1.0 in both. Same instruction length; no pool cell is written.
